morgan: Postmortem follow-up: token surge + delayed ledger writes from 2026-03-18 caused late invoices and some overstated token totals. Need clear owners for reconciliation, customer credits, and detection hardening.

asha: I'll own customer credits and invoice patches. plan: auto-small-credit up to $25, manual review for >$500. ETA Tue 2026-03-24.

kai: i'll take detection/hardening. steps: add idempotency on ingest, tighten consumer checkpointing, and add a replay-safe flag. target Wed 2026-03-25.

diego: infra/ops will handle the live mitigation: pause backfill window and run a dry-backfill in staging to validate dedupe. i'll open PR for pause switch. ETA Mon 2026-03-23.

ellie-fin: finance needs a canonical reconciled CSV with invoice_id, account_id, original_tokens, corrected_tokens, credit_amount, and reason_code. asha pls attach when ready.

billing-bot: New ticket MET-5510 created: "Token surge reconciliation + invoice corrections" assignees: asha,kai,diego due: 2026-03-29

kai: handy query to get suspect invoices (tweak time window as needed):

```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_count) AS total_tokens, COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(inserted_at) AS first_seen, MAX(inserted_at) AS last_seen
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE source = 'metering-consumer' AND inserted_at >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 OR SUM(token_count) > 100000
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 300;
```

Please ack and paste MET-5510 link when you have updates. We'll review at billing sync on Thu. Keep any customer comms coordinated with ellie-fin. :handshake:
